import requests, json

    'deepseek/deepseek-chat-v3-0324',

    'deepseek/deepseek-chat',

    'deepseek/deepseek-v4',
    'deepseek/deepseek-r1-0528',
]
for m in candidates:

        resp = requests.post(
            'http://47.94.22.126/v1/chat/completions',
            headers={'Authorization': '[REDACTED]'},
            json={'model': m, 'messages': [{'role': 'user', 'content': 'Hello'}], 'max_tokens': 5},
            timeout=30
        )
        j = resp.json()
        if resp.status_code == 200 and 'choices' in j:
            content = j['choices'][0]['message'].get('content', '(none)')
            actual = j.get('model', '?')
            print(f'OK  {m} -> actual={actual}, reply={content}')
        else:
            err = j.get('error', {}).get('message', json.dumps(j)[:150])
            print(f'ERR {m} -> {resp.status_code}: {err}')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'EXC {m} -> {e}')
"

Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files.
